using JSON3
using CUDA
import JACC
out = Dict{String,Any}()
out["julia"] = sprint(versioninfo)
out["jacc"] = string(pkgversion(JACC)); out["cuda_jl"] = string(pkgversion(CUDA))
out["gpu"] = CUDA.name(CUDA.device()); out["capability"] = string(CUDA.capability(CUDA.device()))
out["max_grid_dim_y"] = CUDA.attribute(CUDA.device(), CUDA.DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_MAX_GRID_DIM_Y)
out["driver"] = string(CUDA.driver_version()); out["runtime"] = string(CUDA.runtime_version())
out["backend"] = string(JACC.default_backend())
fill2d!(i, j, x) = (x[i, j] = 1; nothing)
function run(M, N)
    x = JACC.zeros(Int8, M, N)
    try
        JACC.parallel_for((M, N), fill2d!, x)
        return Dict("ok" => true, "sum" => Int(sum(Array(x))), "expected" => M * N)
    catch e
        return Dict("ok" => false, "error" => first(sprint(showerror, e), 700), "type" => string(typeof(e)))
    end
end
out["small_32x1000"] = run(32, 1000)
out["tall_32x4194304"] = run(32, 2^22)
println(JSON3.write(out))
